ei.subject: 2026년 3월 고2 모의고사
ei.title: Agricultural Land Use and Global Food Demand

fullPassage:
Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant.
(A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991.
(B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology.
(C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor. However, the growing global population will always demand more food.

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence ①<u>suggests</u> that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC. Over the millennia, continuous innovations have ②<u>boost</u> agricultural productivity while ③<u>reducing</u> manual labor. The growing population will always ④<u>demand</u> more food.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② boost → boosted: have + p.p. = 현재완료. have boosted.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suggests: 적절
❌ ② boost: 어법 오류
✅ ③ reducing: 적절
✅ ④ demand: 적절
det.tip: 현재완료: have/has + p.p. have boosted = 높여 왔다

questions.passage: It is ①<u>projected</u> that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, ②<u>which</u> will require global food production to rise. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is ③<u>suit</u> for farming due to ④<u>limitations</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ suit → suitable: is + 형용사. suitable for = ~에 적합한.
det.analysis:
✅ ① projected: 적절
✅ ② which: 적절
❌ ③ suit: 어법 오류
✅ ④ limitations: 적절
det.tip: be suitable for = ~에 적합하다. suit(동사) → suitable(형용사)

questions.passage: Political and economic factors, ①<u>including</u> land ownership patterns, also ②<u>influence</u> agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land ③<u>using</u> for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles ④<u>was</u> used.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ using → used: land used for agriculture = 농업에 사용되는 토지. 수동의 의미이므로 p.p.
det.analysis:
✅ ① including: 전치사/분사, ~을 포함하여
✅ ② influence: 복수 주어 factors + 복수 동사
❌ ③ using → used: land (which is) used for = 수동
✅ ④ was: 18.6 million square miles(양) + 단수
det.tip: land used for = 사용되는 토지 (수동 분사). using = 능동

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being ①<u>cultivated</u> as early as 9500 BC. It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will ②<u>increase</u> to 9.7 billion. Global food production needs to rise by at least 70% to ③<u>meet</u> demand. Political factors also ④<u>influence</u> agricultural land use.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것이 없으면 ⑤를 고르시오.

det.korean: 모두 어법상 올바름.
det.analysis:
✅ ① cultivated: were being + p.p.(과거진행수동)
✅ ② increase: will + V원형
✅ ③ meet: to + V원형(목적)
✅ ④ influence: factors(복수) + 복수 동사
det.tip: were being cultivated = 과거 진행 수동. to meet = 충족하기 위해

questions.passage: Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing __________ labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 혁신이 수작업(manual) 노동을 줄였다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ manual(수작업의): 원문 일치
❌ ① digital(디지털): 문맥과 다름
❌ ② mental(정신적): 다른 의미
❌ ④ voluntary(자발적): 다른 의미
det.tip: manual labor = 수작업 노동, 육체 노동

questions.passage: Continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity. The growing population will demand more food. Only a small portion of the Earth's surface is ①<u>suitable</u> for farming. Political factors ②<u>influence</u> land use. The amount of land for agriculture has been ③<u>expanding</u>. In 2013, 18.6 million square miles was used compared to ④<u>19.5</u> million in 1991.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ expanding(확대되는) → declining(감소하는): 19.5M(1991) → 18.6M(2013) = 감소.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suitable: 원문 일치
✅ ② influence: 원문 일치
❌ ③ expanding: 원문은 declining — 반의어
✅ ④ 19.5: 원문 일치(1991년 수치)
det.tip: declining(감소하는) ↔ expanding(확대되는). 숫자로 확인: 19.5→18.6

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"기원전 9500년경 레반트에서 작물이 재배되고 있었다."

det.korean: T: 원문과 일치.
det.analysis: ✅ T: cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant
det.tip: as early as = ~만큼 이른. 9500 BC = 기원전 9500년

questions.passage: In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"2013년의 농업용 토지 면적은 1991년보다 증가했다."

det.tip: compared to = ~와 비교하여. 19.5M → 18.6M = 약 0.9M 감소

questions.passage: It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"2050년까지 세계 식량 생산은 최소 70% 이상 증가해야 한다."

det.korean: T: 원문과 일치.
det.analysis: ✅ T: rise by at least 70%
det.tip: by at least 70% = 최소 70% 이상. to meet demand = 수요 충족

questions.passage:
Innovations boosted productivity. Population demands more food. Only a small portion is suitable for farming. Agricultural land is declining.

The central dilemma discussed in the passage is that __________
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글의 핵심 딜레마: 식량 수요는 증가하는데 농경지는 감소하고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② food demand is growing while available farmland is shrinking: 핵심 딜레마
❌ ① 기술이 부족: 혁신이 있었음
❌ ③ 인구가 감소: 반대
❌ ④ 모든 토지가 적합: 반대
det.tip: 딜레마: 수요 증가(인구 ↑) vs 공급 제한(농경지 ↓)

ch: there is no technology for farming
the global population is declining rapidly
food demand is growing while available farmland is shrinking
all of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming

questions.passage:
The correct order is (A)-(C)-(B). After the introduction about ancient cultivation:

The passage flows logically because (A) discusses __________
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)는 정치/경제적 요인과 농경지 감소 추세를 논의하며 도입부와 연결.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ political/economic factors and the decline in farmland, connecting to the introduction: 논리적 순서
❌ ① 미래 인구: (B)의 내용
❌ ② 혁신의 역사: (C)의 내용
❌ ④ 기후변화: 직접 논의하지 않음
det.tip: 순서: 도입(고대 재배) → (A)현재 요인/감소 → (C)혁신/수요 → (B)미래 전망

ch: the effects of climate change on crops
political and economic factors affecting farmland, linking to the introduction's theme of agriculture

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 기후, 지형, 토양, 기술 등의 한계로 지구 표면의 작은 부분만 농업에 적합하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 제한 요인으로 농경 적합지 제한: 원문 일치
❌ ① 대부분의 토지가 적합: 반대 — small portion
❌ ② 기술만이 유일한 한계: 여러 요인
❌ ③ 한계가 없다: 반대
det.tip: limitations: climate, topography, soil quality, technology

ch: 기후, 지형, 토양, 기술 등의 한계로 농경 적합지가 제한된다.

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 혁신은 수작업 노동을 증가시켰다 → 원문은 reducing(줄이는).
det.analysis:
✅ ① 혁신이 생산성을 높임: 원문 일치
✅ ② 인구 증가가 더 많은 식량을 요구: 원문 일치
❌ ③ 혁신이 노동 증가: 원문은 reducing
✅ ④ 수천 년에 걸쳐 혁신이 이루어짐: 원문 일치
det.tip: reducing manual labor = 수작업 노동 감소. 증가가 아님

ch: 지속적인 혁신이 농업 생산성을 높여 왔다.
늘어나는 세계 인구는 항상 더 많은 식량을 요구할 것이다.
수천 년에 걸쳐 농업 혁신이 이루어졌다.

questions.passage: (a) Archaeological evidence suggests cultivation since 9500 BC. (b) Continuous innovations have boosted productivity. (c) By 2050, the population will increase to 7.9 billion. (d) The amount of farmland has been declining.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분이 포함된 문장은?

det.korean: (c) 7.9 billion → 9.7 billion: 원문은 9.7 billion.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (a)
❌ ② (b)
✅ ③ (c)
❌ ④ (d)
✅ (a) 원문 그대로
✅ (b) 원문 그대로
❌ (c) 7.9 billion → 9.7 billion: 숫자 변경
✅ (d) 원문 그대로
det.tip: 9.7 billion(97억) ≠ 7.9 billion(79억). 숫자를 정확히 기억

In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 영어 단어를 쓰시오. Only a small portion of the Earth's surface is __________ for farming.

det.korean: suitable(적합한): 지구 표면의 작은 부분만이 농업에 적합하다.
det.analysis: ✅ suitable: 원문 그대로
det.tip: suitable for = ~에 적합한

questions.passage: Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor. However, the growing global population will always demand more food.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

Continuous innovations have boosted agricultural (produce).

det.korean: 동사 produce를 명사 productivity로 변환. agricultural + 명사.
det.analysis: ✅ productivity: produce(동사) → productivity(생산성, 명사)
det.tip: produce(생산하다) → production(생산) / productivity(생산성)

questions.passage: It is projected that the world's population will increase.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 어순으로 배열하시오.

[ this / despite / need ]

__________, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming.

det.korean: Despite this need: 이러한 필요에도 불구하고.
det.analysis: ✅ Despite this need: despite + 명사구
det.tip: despite = in spite of = ~에도 불구하고

questions.passage: Crops since 9500 BC. Innovations boosted productivity. Population will reach 9.7B by 2050. Only small portion suitable. Farmland declining.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 증가하는 식량 수요와 감소하는 농경지 사이의 도전
det.analysis:
✅ ① 수요 증가 vs 농경지 감소: 핵심 딜레마
❌ ② 고대 농업의 역사: 일부분
❌ ③ 혁신의 부작용: 글의 주제 아님
❌ ④ 인구 감소 대책: 반대
det.tip: 핵심: demand ↑ + farmland ↓ = 도전

ch: 증가하는 식량 수요와 감소하는 농경지 사이의 도전

questions.passage: Agriculture since 9500 BC. Innovations increased productivity. Population growing, farmland declining. Limitations exist.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요약문으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 농업 혁신에도 불구하고 인구 증가와 농경지 감소로 식량 공급에 도전이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 혁신 + 인구 ↑ + 농경지 ↓ = 도전: 글의 요지
❌ ① 농업은 더 이상 불필요: 반대
❌ ③ 모든 토지가 적합: 반대
❌ ④ 인구가 감소 중: 반대
det.tip: 핵심: innovations + population growth + declining farmland + limitations

ch: 농업은 현대 사회에서 더 이상 필요하지 않다.
세계 인구는 감소하고 있어 식량 문제가 없다.
농업 혁신에도 불구하고 인구 증가와 농경지 감소로 식량 공급에 도전이 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 옮기시오.

"농업에 사용되는 토지의 양은 감소해 왔다."

det.korean: The amount of land used for agriculture has been declining.
det.analysis: ✅ 현재완료진행: has been declining
det.tip: has been declining = 감소해 왔다 (현재완료진행). the amount of = ~의 양
